nodes.label: STORY-001 (PRD-004): Offload run_query to a worker thread
asyncio.to_thread offload of blocking pipeline call
nodes.rationale: The synchronous run_query(...) call inside ChatState.send() is wrapped in await asyncio.to_thread(...) so a slow OpenRouter call runs on a worker thread instead of blocking the single Reflex event loop, keeping every other session's page responsive while one session's request is in flight. Chosen over restructuring run_query() itself, so behavior, exceptions and output stay byte-for-byte identical (no visual change in this story).
